title: BMW iX3 Achieves 500 Miles on Single Charge in Real-World Testing
detail: BMW's new iX3 achieved 500 miles (805 km) on a single charge in real-world testing — a significant range milestone for production electric vehicles, surpassing WLTP-certified figures and demonstrating that real-world range is converging toward lab benchmarks. The result highlights advances in battery energy density and vehicle efficiency management.
